title: Aircrew briefing to Congress: not a false hit
summary: Marik von Rennenkampf tells of Aircrew briefing to Congress: not a false hit, about 2015 (event); later briefing at Washington, D.C., and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: what do you think he meant when when u they brief Congress and says we knew it was not a false hit.

plain: Marik von Rennenkampf, a commentator on UFO cases, spoke in 2025 on the show of a podcast host, Jesse Michels, in an episode where a UFO skeptic named Mick West was challenged to a debate. He pointed to a 2015 encounter involving a military aircrew and relayed that someone, later briefing the US Congress, said "we knew it was not a false hit," meaning the sensor reading was not a glitch. If true, it would mean the object the crew tracked was real.
